title.zh: 把这个场景搬到 WebGPU，能快多少
title.en: What WebGPU would actually buy this scene

summary.zh: 现在的瓶颈在填充率和后处理链，不在绘制调用。按带宽算一遍，预期提升 10–20%，值得做一个一天的 spike，不值得整个重写。
summary.en: The cost is fill rate and the post chain, not draw calls. Budgeting the bandwidth says 10–20 percent, which is worth a one-day spike and not worth a rewrite.

zh: 同一画面在 WebGPU 下每帧 GPU 时间会少多少？
把 onBeforeCompile 的补丁改成节点材质，要动多少行？
什么条件下值得整体迁移，什么条件下保持 WebGL2？
en: How much less GPU time per frame does the same image cost under WebGPU?
How many lines does it take to turn the onBeforeCompile patches into node materials?
When is a full migration worth it, and when does WebGL2 stay?
